units.rawText: Magrasea doesn't have anything like this. Riko's instincts say this is a huge gold mine...

units.rawText: Uwaaaahh! Where did you come from, Professor! Wait a minute, where did all those wounds on you come from? You're not here to haunt Riko, are you?!
units.displayText: Uwaaaahh! Where did you come from, Professor! Wait a minute, where did all those wounds on you come from? You're not here to haunt Riko, are you?!

units.rawText: Relax, I clawed my way out of hell... Though I'm this close to falling over.
units.displayText: Relax, I clawed my way out of hell... Though I'm this close to falling over.

spans.text: Relax, I clawed my way out of hell... Though I'm this close to falling over.

units.displayText: I grab my chest and pretend that I'm done for.

units.rawText: Before I go... I need to see...
units.displayText: Before I go... I need to see...

spans.text: Before I go... I need to see...

units.rawText: Yes, yes, I know! Don't collapse in front of Riko, Professor! I can't foot your medical and insurance bills!
units.displayText: Yes, yes, I know! Don't collapse in front of Riko, Professor! I can't foot your medical and insurance bills!

spans.text: Yes, yes, I know! Don't collapse in front of Riko, Professor! I can't foot your medical and insurance bills!

units.rawText: I couldn't find that Upa, but I managed to custom-make something that looks just like it...
units.displayText: I couldn't find that Upa, but I managed to custom-make something that looks just like it...

spans.text: I couldn't find that Upa, but I managed to custom-make something that looks just like it...

units.rawText: Is that an Upa? I didn't know you were into plushies like this, comrade...
units.displayText: Is that an Upa? I didn't know you were into plushies like this, comrade...

spans.text: Is that an Upa? I didn't know you were into plushies like this, comrade...

units.rawText: (Cough) I'll tell you about it later.
units.displayText: (Cough) I'll tell you about it later.

spans.text: (Cough) I'll tell you about it later.

units.rawText: What do you mean you'll talk about it later! That, that was made at 5 times the going rate!
units.displayText: What do you mean you'll talk about it later! That, that was made at 5 times the going rate!

spans.text: What do you mean you'll talk about it later! That, that was made at 5 times the going rate!

units.rawText: ...I won't shortchange you on Diggcoins, Riko. What about your kei van?
units.displayText: ...I won't shortchange you on Diggcoins, Riko. What about your kei van?

spans.text: ...I won't shortchange you on Diggcoins, Riko. What about your kei van?

units.rawText: Undine parked it behind the cafe... Wait, why did you suddenly ask Riko about that?
units.displayText: Undine parked it behind the cafe... Wait, why did you suddenly ask Riko about that?

spans.text: Undine parked it behind the cafe... Wait, why did you suddenly ask Riko about that?

units.rawText: Ah, Fox... I mean, Riko-san, how's the van doing?
units.displayText: Ah, Fox... I mean, Riko-san, how's the van doing?

spans.text: Ah, Fox... I mean, Riko-san, how's the van doing?

units.rawText: Hm? The questions are getting weirder and weirder...
units.displayText: Hm? The questions are getting weirder and weirder...

spans.text: Hm? The questions are getting weirder and weirder...

units.rawText: That van is Riko's most precious treasure. Of course it's been well taken care of. Um, although Riko hasn't tidied it up in a long time...

spans.text: That van is Riko's most precious treasure. Of course it's been well taken care of. Um, although Riko hasn't tidied it up in a long time...

units.rawText: ...Hm? Why are you laughing? Did Riko say something strange?
units.displayText: ...Hm? Why are you laughing? Did Riko say something strange?

spans.text: ...Hm? Why are you laughing? Did Riko say something strange?

units.rawText: It's not like that. To us, she's just as important and irreplaceable.
units.displayText: It's not like that. To us, she's just as important and irreplaceable.

spans.text: It's not like that. To us, she's just as important and irreplaceable.

units.rawText: Riko, can you take us to see your van?
units.displayText: Riko, can you take us to see your van?

spans.text: Riko, can you take us to see your van?

units.rawText: Riko opens the boot, and the crate where Mayuri is sleeping is in the same place as before.
units.displayText: Riko opens the boot, and the crate where Mayuri is sleeping is in the same place as before.

spans.text: Riko opens the boot, and the crate where Mayuri is sleeping is in the same place as before.

units.rawText: For some reason, my heart pounds violently when I see that crate.
units.displayText: For some reason, my heart pounds violently when I see that crate.

spans.text: For some reason, my heart pounds violently when I see that crate.

units.rawText: ...Comrade, do you know about Schrodinger's Cat?
units.displayText: ...Comrade, do you know about Schrodinger's Cat?

spans.text: ...Comrade, do you know about Schrodinger's Cat?

units.rawText: Don't you think it's very bad luck to talk about it at a time like this?
units.displayText: Don't you think it's very bad luck to talk about it at a time like this?

spans.text: Don't you think it's very bad luck to talk about it at a time like this?

units.rawText: Indeed. Mayuri is clearly not going to be in a quantum state... I just reflexively thought about it when I saw the crate.
units.displayText: Indeed. Mayuri is clearly not going to be in a quantum state... I just reflexively thought about it when I saw the crate.

spans.text: Indeed. Mayuri is clearly not going to be in a quantum state... I just reflexively thought about it when I saw the crate.

units.displayText: ...Feeling nervous?

spans.text: ...Feeling nervous?

units.rawText: Yeah...
units.displayText: Yeah...

spans.text: Yeah...

units.rawText: Trust in our choices and our efforts... Go on. Mayuri's waiting for you.
units.displayText: Trust in our choices and our efforts... Go on. Mayuri's waiting for you.

spans.text: Trust in our choices and our efforts... Go on. Mayuri's waiting for you.

units.displayText: I gently pat Okabe on the back, pushing him forward.

units.displayText: Okabe reaches out and slowly lifts the lid—

spans.text: Okabe reaches out and slowly lifts the lid—

units.displayText: Revealing a black-haired girl, sound asleep within.

units.displayText: Zzz... Zzz...
